author: Insta360
description:
Ever felt like your movements were holding back your gimbal shot potential? We've got you covered!

It's often not the gear itself, but how you move. This guide breaks down practical gimbal movement techniques to help you create smoother, more intentional shots using a gimbal stabilizer for phone filmmaking.

Huge thanks to @LearnOnlineVideo for helping us create this one! 

In the market for a next-gen, AI-powered gimbal? Check out Flow 2 Pro here://bit.ly/Flow2ProTutorial

#GimbalTutorial  #CinematicShot  #FilmmakingForBeginners 

0:00 Intro
0:33 Wandering vs Planned
1:30 Ignoring vs Foreground
2:36 One Format vs Multi-Platform
3:48 Layering Motion Inside Motion
4:52 Sprinting vs Gliding
5:40 Smart Transitions
7:10 Brake Slam vs Cinematic Settle
7:41 Forward vs Tilt Reveals
